note: Provenance for derived rules — the `rules/` counterpart to skills-provenance.json, and the same hand-owned model in every respect: the reader-facing mirror is a `## Attribution` section at the end of the rule, one flat bullet per source in this array's order, and check-payload holds the two in agreement with the same checker it runs over skills. A rule has no vendored tier — `npx skills` does not manage rules/, so there is no lock file beside this one and every rule in the payload is first-party, which makes an unrecorded `## Attribution` a failure here where it is excusable for a vendored skill. `relationship` decides sync behavior; `ref` is the upstream commit this rule is reconciled through as of `reviewed`. INITIAL PINS are baselines set to current upstream HEAD on the import date — they mean 'watch from here', not 'verified byte-identical to that commit'.

relationships.adapted: Forked from the source, then intentionally diverged. Has a `ref`. Sync = 3-way reconcile (diff ref..HEAD, port non-conflicting changes, then bump `ref`+`reviewed`). Never overwrite.
relationships.spec: Conforms to an external normative specification rather than forking code. Watch the spec `url`/version; reconcile when the spec revises.
relationships.inspired-by: Ideas, structure, or terminology only — no code lineage. Attribution only; the drift checker skips these (no `ref`).
